reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI. It's a conversation spanning the history, present, and future of OpenAI, from the origin of ChatGPT through Codex, hardware, and their new Jalapeno chip. We discuss the early decision to buy compute at a scale nobody thought was rational.

key_points.text: We discuss the early decision to buy compute at a scale nobody thought was rational.
We talk about Kimi and distillation, the Hugging Face incident and what it means for the pace of AI development.
Please enjoy my conversation with Sam Altman.
